jobs.occupation: Dean (m/f/d): School of Science (Professor/in - Hochschulen)
jobs.description: The Executive Board and Provost of Constructor University invite applications for the position ofDean (m/f/d) of the School of Science(Full-time; 38.5 hours/week, limited to 5 years)The expected starting date is 01.09.2027.  A regular presence on campus in Bremen is required.About Constructor UniversityConstructor University (CU) is a private, research-driven, international university in Germany, with students from more than 100 countries. Three schools—Science,  Computer Science and Engineering, and Business, Social and Decision Sciences,   - offer interdisciplinary undergraduate, graduate and doctoral programs committed to excellence in teaching, research, and innovation in higher education.In 2022, CU has become part of the global Constructor ecosystem, with its three complementing pillars (Constructor Knowledge, including  CU; Constructor Tech, focusing on digital solutions for teaching and  learning; and Constructor Capital, an early-stage capital firm investing in Deep Tech, Software, and Edtech). About the School of ScienceThe School of Science brings together basic and applied research with research-led education in an international and interdisciplinary environment. With particular strengths in the natural and life sciences, including physics, chemistry, mathematics, and biological sciences, the School currently offers 6 Bachelor and 2 interdisciplinary Master programs to around 350 students. Students benefit from close interaction with faculty, access to modern laboratories and research facilities, and opportunities to participate in research from an early stage of their studies. Further development of the School of Science is a strategic objective of the university, particularly in the areas of physics and quantum sciences.Your ResponsibilitiesThe Dean of the School of Science is responsible for the academic leadership, strategic development, and effective management of the School. The Dean oversees academic staffing, including workforce planning, faculty recruitment, performance evaluation, and professional development, ensuring that the School has the expertise and capacity required to deliver its teaching and research objectives. The Dean is responsible for developing and managing the School's budget, allocating resources effectively, and ensuring financial sustainability. Working with faculty and university leadership, the Dean leads the development, review, and improvement of study programs, ensuring academic quality, relevance, innovation, and alignment with student needs and emerging scientific developments. The Dean also develops and implements the School's long-term strategy, identifying opportunities for research excellence, new academic programs, interdisciplinary collaboration, external partnerships, and revenue generation, while ensuring alignment with the University's overall mission, priorities, and institutional strategy. The Dean is accountable for the School's academic performance, financial management, and contribution to the University's success.Role RequirementsThe Dean is expected to provide academic leadership while fostering a collaborative, international, and innovative academic environment. Candidates should:- Demonstrate the ability to provide strategic leadership for the academic development of the School in alignment with the university’s mission and long-term goals- Lead and mentor a diverse faculty body while supporting professional development- Develop interdisciplinary collaboration both within and across schools- Strengthen the School’s international profile and academic partnerships- Foster innovation in digital and emerging forms of teaching and learning- Manage resources effectively, including budget planning and strategic allocation of funds- Represent the School within the university and externally to academic, scientific, and industry stakeholders.Your QualificationsDeans should radiate academic and intellectual gravitas and display evident leadership qualities. Their academic and scientific experience and insight should be at the level where they are respected as accomplished academics both within Constructor University and in the broader academic community. In particular, as senior academics and managers at Constructor University, Deans must- have a Ph.D. in a field of the school and teaching and research experience of at least ten years- hold a full professorship or equivalent- have a proven track record of hands-on experience with the European/German research grant landscape- exhibit previous personal involvement in relevant high-level academic administrative processes and leadership activities in a relevant academic or scientific institution- present evidence of strategic thinking and management- have an understanding of the economic and strategic context of academic and scientific activities in a university- possess excellent interpersonal and communication skills, and demonstrate the ability to work in and with teams- express familiarity with international higher education structures and landscapes- exhibit fluency in English, the medium of instruction at Constructor UniversityWhat you can expect at Constructor UniversityWe are an international, world-class private university embarking on an exciting journey of growth and expanding our portfolio. jobs.occupation: Laser Engineer / Optical Engineer (m/f/d) (Ingenieur/in - Augenoptik, Optometrie)
jobs.description: The Max Planck Society is Germany's premier research organization. The 85 Max Planck Institutes conduct research at highest levels, in the service of the general public, in the natural sciences, life sciences, social sciences, and the humanities.At the Max Planck Institute for the Structure and Dynamics of Matter (MPSD), around 180 staff members and guests investigate how the structure of solids determines their dynamic properties. The institute is located on the Bahrenfeld research campus in Hamburg, in the immediate vicinity of DESY and the University of Hamburg.Ultrashort pulses of light can be used to deliberately change the properties of quantum materials. For picoseconds and longer, a solid can become superconducting or its magnetic and crystal structure can rearrange. This fundamental research is made possible by highly advanced laser systems and complex optical setups. To operate and further develop them, we are looking for aLaser Engineer / Optical Engineer (m/f/d)In the laser laboratories of the Quantum Condensed Matter Dynamics department, we study how the electronic, magnetic and structural properties of quantum materials can be controlled with light. For our time-resolved optical experiments, we operate femtosecond laser systems and nonlinear optical sources that cover a broad spectral range from the visible to the terahertz regime. In addition, we carry out time-resolved X-ray experiments at free-electron lasers worldwide. Further details can be found on our website https://qcmd.mpsd.mpg.de (https://qcmd.mpsd.mpg.de/) .Your responsibilitiesYou ensure that our femtosecond laser systems and optical setups run reliably and continue to evolve, working closely with our team of scientists.In detail, your tasks include:- Operation and regular alignment of our femtosecond amplifiers and nonlinear optical sources (e.g. OPAs, difference frequency conversion, THz generation)- Planning and building new optical setups, from beam delivery to commissioning- CAD design of opto-mechanical components and vacuum parts, and coordination with our mechanical workshop from drawing to installation- Regular maintenance of the laser systems and their peripherals (cooling, vacuum pumps), and coordination of service and repairs with external companies- Support during beamtimes at free-electron lasers as neededYour profileYou have- A Master’s degree in optics, photonics, laser technology, engineering physics or a related field- Alternatively, a Bachelor’s degree with relevant professional experience- Hands-on experience with ultrafast lasers and with building and aligning optical systems- Knowledge of nonlinear optics and optical measurement techniques- Proficiency in CAD software (preferably Autodesk Inventor)- Experience with vacuum technology and optical simulation (e.g. Zemax)- A careful, independent working style and enjoyment of working in an international team- Very good command of English and GermanWhat we offerThe position is initially limited to 2 years, with the possibility of conversion to a permanent contract. Salary and social benefits are based on qualifications and in accordance with the collective agreement for the German public sector (TVöD).Are you insterested?Please apply exclusively via our online application portal.The Max Planck Society seeks to employ more individuals with severe disabilities. Applications from individuals with severe disabilities are expressly encouraged.The Max Planck Society strives for gender equality and diversity. We welcome applications from all backgrounds.For further information, please contact Dr. Michael Först (phone +49 40 8998-88105, email: michael.foerst@mpsd.mpg.de (https://www.b-ite.com/recruitingmanager/api/v3/job-postings/c5aebe39-8931-4b83-9f2f-9d396b13d2f9/michael.foerst@mpsd.mpg.de) ) or Dr. Michele Buzzi (phone +49 40 8998-88115, email: michele.buzzi@mpsd.mpg.de (https://mailto:michele.buzzi@mpsd.mpg.de) ).More information is available on our website: http://www.mpsd.mpg.de/karriere/jobs.We look forward to receiving your complete application in English by 15 December 2026
